skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of logic and propositions.
Apply mathematical induction to prove statements.
Manipulate sets using various operations and understand their properties.
Define and manipulate functions and relations, including binary relations.
Understand and explain the basics of algorithms, including their design and analysis.
Implement and analyze search algorithms such as linear search and binary search.
Implement and analyze sorting algorithms like bubble sort and quicksort.
Analyze the time complexity of algorithms using Big O notation.
Design and implement recursive algorithms.
Apply number theory algorithms for tasks such as finding prime numbers and factorization.
Understand and apply the principles of the RSA cryptosystem.
Apply basic counting principles to solve combinatorial problems.
Calculate permutations and combinations for solving counting problems.
Generate permutations and combinations algorithmically.
Apply the Dirichlet principle to solve existence problems.
Understand and apply fundamental concepts of graph theory.
Identify and work with special types of graphs such as trees and bipartite graphs.
Represent graphs using adjacency matrices and adjacency lists.
Determine whether a graph is connected and find its components.
Find Euler paths and circuits in graphs.
Find Hamilton paths and circuits in graphs.
Apply shortest path algorithms such as Dijkstra's algorithm.
Determine if a graph is planar and apply Kuratowski's theorem.
Apply graph coloring techniques to solve real-world problems.
Understand and apply tree structures in problem-solving.
Find spanning trees and minimum spanning trees in graphs.
Implement and analyze tree traversal algorithms such as DFS and BFS.
Apply algorithmic thinking to solve complex problems.
Develop self-learning skills to independently study and understand new concepts.
Work independently on assignments and projects.
Collaborate effectively in teams to complete group assignments.
Take responsibility for personal actions and contributions to the team.
